details.summary: Hong Kong medical officer and seventh Director-General of the World Health Organization (WHO) 2007-2017
details.life: Was born 21 August 1947 in Hong Kong. Her parents’ names and professions are not currently publicly available. She married David Chan, ophthalmologist, with whom she has one son.
details.editors: Bob Reinalda, Kent J. Kille and Jaci L. Eisenberg
